nodes.label: AI co-producer (Ask AI tab, per-user Anthropic/OpenRouter keys)
nodes.norm_label: ai co-producer (ask ai tab, per-user anthropic/openrouter keys)
nodes.rationale: Runs on each person's own key so the site does not pay; keys encrypted with AI_KEY_SECRET (web/src/lib/aiKeys.ts); OpenRouter called server-side only (web/src/lib/openrouter.ts).

nodes.label: AI producer panel (aiIdeas.ts, aiTrial.ts, AiProducer.tsx)
nodes.rationale: Made for people who never used a music app; fixes change timing, key and volume only, never effects; all analysis runs in the browser.

nodes.label: Arrangement engine (lib/client/analysis.ts, arrange.ts)
nodes.rationale: Signal analysis, not a remote model; arranges vocal phrase by phrase on the beat's bars without changing pitch.

nodes.label: Clip editing pure functions (lib/client/clipEdit.ts, clipCommands.ts)
nodes.rationale: Editing is pure functions shared by menu, toolbar and shortcuts; every edit is one undo step.

nodes.label: Sync templates (Perfect sync, Beat leads, Vocal leads, ...)
nodes.norm_label: sync templates (perfect sync, beat leads, vocal leads, ...)

nodes.label: JSON settings columns (remix_lanes.settings_json, remixes.project_json)
nodes.rationale: JSON columns let the mixer grow without a migration per knob; older remixes fall back to defaults.

nodes.label: Options stack (ideas compose; same-kind choices replace)
nodes.norm_label: options stack (ideas compose; same-kind choices replace)
nodes.rationale: Choosing one idea never discards others; only the same kind of choice makes way, and tapping plays immediately from the playhead.

nodes.label: SoundTouch offline rendering for pitch/tempo
nodes.rationale: Pitch/tempo changes re-render a stem buffer once like a DAW freeze, not a live audio worklet, which keeps multi-lane sync simple.

nodes.label: Cloudflare R2 stem storage
nodes.rationale: 10 GB free but needs a payment card; when R2_BUCKET is set it takes priority over Blob.

nodes.label: All-in-one Docker image (app + Postgres + Caddy, /data volume)
nodes.norm_label: all-in-one docker image (app + postgres + caddy, /data volume)
nodes.rationale: Everything that must survive updates (database, stems, session secret, TLS certs) lives in one /data volume.

nodes.label: Oracle Cloud Always Free ARM server setup
nodes.norm_label: oracle cloud always free arm server setup

nodes.label: Vercel Blob stem store
nodes.rationale: Public mode streams directly from Blob CDN (more efficient); private mode makes the app proxy stems 4 MB at a time.

nodes.label: Free on Vercel with Neon and Vercel Blob
nodes.norm_label: free on vercel with neon and vercel blob
nodes.rationale: Recommended: app, database and stems all managed from one Vercel dashboard, no credit card; Vercel Hobby is non-commercial only.

nodes.label: Song import from link via yt-dlp (/api/import)
nodes.norm_label: song import from link via yt-dlp (/api/import)
nodes.rationale: YouTube links are off by default because YouTube blocks downloads from cloud data centres; YTDLP_PROXY or YTDLP_COOKIES re-enable them. Imported audio is kept briefly under imports/ and swept after an hour.

nodes.label: Google Search Console site verification file
nodes.norm_label: google search console site verification file

nodes.label: Before opening to the public (copyright, no quotas, non-commercial)
nodes.norm_label: before opening to the public (copyright, no quotas, non-commercial)
nodes.rationale: Uploads of commercial songs need terms of use and takedown contact; anyone can sign up with no per-user quota; Vercel free plan is non-commercial.

nodes.label: Cloudflare Tunnel deployment (no open ports)
nodes.rationale: If outbound UDP is blocked, add --protocol http2.

nodes.label: Sessions as signed JWT in HTTP-only cookie
nodes.norm_label: sessions as signed jwt in http-only cookie

nodes.label: Named Cloudflare tunnel with --protocol http2
nodes.rationale: QUIC (UDP 7844) is blocked on this network, so share.sh forces --protocol http2.

nodes.label: serveo SSH tunnel provider
nodes.rationale: ssh -N does not work because serveo sends the URL over the session channel; share.sh uses -T with stdin from /dev/null.

nodes.label: share.sh public tunnel for local Remixt
nodes.norm_label: share.sh public tunnel for local remixt
nodes.rationale: Keeps app, database and audio local, only putting a public HTTPS address in front of :3000.

nodes.label: Cross-origin isolation (COOP/COEP in next.config.ts)
nodes.rationale: Pages are cross-origin isolated so the WebAssembly fallback can use every CPU core.

nodes.label: Cloudflare quick tunnel blocked by DNS poisoning
nodes.norm_label: cloudflare quick tunnel blocked by dns poisoning
nodes.rationale: trycloudflare.com is DNS-poisoned on this network, so quick tunnels can never register; named tunnels still work.

nodes.label: DATABASE_URL (pooled) vs DATABASE_URL_UNPOOLED
nodes.rationale: App uses the pooled URL; migrations via scripts/migrate.mjs use the unpooled URL.

nodes.label: Schema setup (web/scripts/schema.sql, scripts/migrate.mjs)
nodes.rationale: Schema is applied on every Docker start and is idempotent.

nodes.label: Community features (web/src/lib/social.ts)
nodes.rationale: follows and remix_comments tables are created on first use and are in schema.sql.

nodes.label: Pooled vs direct connections gotcha
nodes.rationale: Use the direct (unpooled) URL for migrations, dumps and replication because pooled PgBouncer transaction mode breaks session-level operations.

nodes.label: Python separation service dependencies (FastAPI, demucs 4.0.1, librosa)
nodes.norm_label: python separation service dependencies (fastapi, demucs 4.0.1, librosa)

nodes.label: Legacy separation-service (Python/Demucs, unused)
nodes.rationale: Kept only for reference; nothing uses it since splitting moved to the browser.

nodes.label: Split lane with Demucs (laneSplit.ts, beatParts.ts, SplitLaneDialog.tsx)
nodes.norm_label: split lane with demucs (lanesplit.ts, beatparts.ts, splitlanedialog.tsx)

nodes.label: Stem storage selection (Blob, R2, local disk)
nodes.norm_label: stem storage selection (blob, r2, local disk)

nodes.label: Browser upload flow (splitter.ts, splitter.worker.ts, /api/tracks)
nodes.rationale: Decode/resample to 44.1 kHz, Web Worker runs Demucs and sums drums+bass+other into beat, encodes MP3 stems, then POST /api/tracks, upload stems, POST /api/tracks/<id>/complete.

nodes.label: In-browser song splitting
nodes.rationale: Songs are split into vocals and beat in the listener's browser so the server only handles accounts, library and remixes; this lets Remixt run on free hosting and the original file never leaves the device.

nodes.label: On-demand splitter loading on phones/tablets
nodes.rationale: Splitter is not preloaded on mobile and is unloaded after use because iOS reloads a tab that holds too much memory; songs limited to 10 min on mobile (15 on desktop).
